name: DateTime Reset
description: Provides the option to display a reset button in datetime fields.
project_description: DateTime Reset adds a per-widget "Reset" button to core Datetime field widgets. The button is enabled through a third-party widget setting on the Manage form display screen, and when clicked it clears the date and time inputs of that field on the client side. It works with Date, Date/Time and Date range core fields, and includes handling for SmartDate's time_wrapper markup. The module ships only hook implementations, a small JS behavior, config schema for the widget setting, and an asset library; it defines no routes, permissions, services, or plugins.
